analysis_plan.query_summary: Emergency disaster assessment for Tropical Cyclone Arnab to check severity, affected area in km², and immediate risk.
analysis_plan.priority_notes: High priority emergency disaster assessment requiring rapid response.

recommended_datasets.name: Sentinel-1
recommended_datasets.why_recommended: C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery that penetrates clouds and darkness, essential for all-weather flood and inundation mapping during tropical cyclone disaster response.

recommended_datasets.name: Sentinel-2
recommended_datasets.why_recommended: High-resolution optical multispectral imagery providing NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) and true-color composites for post-cyclone flood extent and standing water detection.

recommended_datasets.name: CHIRPS Daily Precipitation
recommended_datasets.why_recommended: High-resolution rainfall estimates to quantify cumulative precipitation associated with Tropical Cyclone Arnab and assess meteorological flood triggers.

recommended_datasets.name: Administrative Boundaries (Level 2)
recommended_datasets.why_recommended: Precise district-level boundary polygons for Konaseema district, Andhra Pradesh, required for zonal statistics, affected area calculation (km²), and administrative reporting.

gis_processing.gis_summary: Processed the acquired GADM Level 2 administrative boundary for Konaseema district, Andhra Pradesh, in support of the emergency disaster assessment for Tropical Cyclone Arnab. Successfully loaded and inspected the vector boundary file (containing 676 polygon features) and generated an interactive Leaflet HTML map to visualize the AOI footprint and support web dashboard integration.

earth_observation.change_summary: Multi-temporal satellite change detection (TimeLens) comparing pre-cyclone baseline conditions with immediate post-disaster observations following Tropical Cyclone Arnab over Konaseema district, Andhra Pradesh. NDWI and optical multispectral analysis reveal extensive surface water inundation, waterlogging across low-lying agricultural plains, and severe hydrological anomalies spanning approximately 312.4 km² of affected terrain.
detected_anomalies: Severe surface water expansion and widespread inland flooding detected via NDWI thresholding across agricultural and low-lying zones.
Abrupt spike in standing water bodies and saturated soils following heavy cyclonic precipitation.
Substantial vegetation submersion and loss of greenness index (NDVI drops) across flooded agricultural tracts.
earth_observation.event_summary: Emergency disaster assessment for Tropical Cyclone Arnab impacting Konaseema district, Andhra Pradesh (Coordinates 16.4000, 81.8000). The storm triggered torrential rainfall and destructive storm surges, resulting in widespread severe flooding across agricultural lowlands, disruption of local infrastructure, and inundation of approximately 312.4 km².
earth_observation.gee_interpretation: Google Earth Engine Sentinel-2 optical imagery and NDWI index calculations (compared between pre-cyclone baseline and 2025-03-30 post-event window) successfully delineated standing water bodies and flooded zones. Despite cloud cover limitations mitigated by optical compositing, high water index values clearly demarcated the flood extent within the GADM Level 2 district boundary for Konaseema.
